newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nine tourists hurt in NZ beach bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Nine tourists hurt in NZ beach bus crash.

text.p: Nine tourists were injured when a tour bus crashed on Monday on Ninety Mile Beach, one of New Zealand's best-known scenic attractions.

A spokesperson for tour operator Kiwi Experience told Reuters 12 people were in the bus when it overturned on Ninety Mile Beach, a flat stretch of sand also used as a road to the tip of New Zealand's North Island.
Passengers included tourists from Ireland, Canada, England, Japan and New Zealand, the spokesperson said. None had been critically injured.
The cause of the crash was not immediately known.
A fireman with the Kaitaia Fire Service, which sent three rescue units to the accident scene, said the bus had rolled on to its roof and was badly damaged.
The most seriously injured tourist was flown by helicopter to Whangarei hospital.
